name: zzzops
description: Agentic engineering with durable goals for autonomous coding agents

interface.longDescription: ZzzOps gives autonomous coding agents a reviewed, prioritized, and resumable agentic-engineering loop: durable goals stored on Git branches, a configurable workflow of agent, human and Git/GitHub phases, stacked pull requests, and batched human decisions. It coordinates implementation only under the repository's policy.
defaultPrompt: Review and initialize this project's ZzzOps policy.
Capture a durable project goal with ZzzOps.
Work all available ZzzOps goals until blocked.
